literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) come from PMC9291319 and describe a Myc-tagged CD200R1L construct used to validate an anti-CD200R1L antibody. They fail to qualify on two independent grounds. First, the tagged protein is CD200R1L (the activating receptor, a distinct gene product), not CD200R1 (the inhibitory receptor, the target of this analysis); a close ortholog might count as indirect evidence, but CD200R1L is a paralog used here only as a specificity control, not as a model for CD200R1 tagging. Second, the construct is explicitly described as a commercial Origene plasmid and the tag position is never stated in either clip; the rules explicitly exclude 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated' because insert_after_residue cannot be pinned. No other ledger lines are present. Zero sites is the correct answer.
